name: Container Homes
description: Set a home URL and up to 9 app slots per Firefox container, then jump to them with the toolbar button or Alt+Shift+Home/1-9.

open-container-homes.description: Open the home URL for the current container

group-tabs-by-container.description: Group and sort this window's tabs by container

focus-previous-group.description: Switch to the first tab of the previous tab group

focus-next-group.description: Switch to the first tab of the next tab group

open-tab-in-group.description: Open a new tab in the current tab's group and container

open-slot-1.description: Switch to or open slot 1 for the current container

open-slot-2.description: Switch to or open slot 2 for the current container

open-slot-3.description: Switch to or open slot 3 for the current container

open-slot-4.description: Switch to or open slot 4 for the current container

open-slot-5.description: Switch to or open slot 5 for the current container

open-slot-6.description: Switch to or open slot 6 for the current container

open-slot-7.description: Switch to or open slot 7 for the current container

open-slot-8.description: Switch to or open slot 8 for the current container

open-slot-9.description: Switch to or open slot 9 for the current container
